literal_meaning: কেশের অগ্রভাগ স্পর্শ করা (hair tip touch করা)
similar_in_english: not harm a hair on one's head
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি আমার কেশাগ্রস্পর্শ করতে পারবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: You won't be able to touch a hair of mine.
The enemies couldn't even cause the slightest harm to him.
note: This idiom emphasizes invulnerability, often used in contexts of defiance or superiority.
